name: Unlimited-OCR
notes: Long-document OCR model in the DeepSeek-OCR line. Each block comes wrapped in <|det|> type and box tags, which are stripped before scoring. Needs TRITON_ALLOW_NON_CONSTEXPR_GLOBALS=1 with vLLM 0.32, like DeepSeek-OCR 2. The first run looped on coordinate tokens (11 of 17 pages cut off) because it ran without the repetition guard the model needs; the guard and the prompt now follow the vLLM recipe. Special tokens are kept so the tags can be stripped.
